display_name: Bao Minh erection (installation) all risks rules: period of insurance, general exclusions and conditions, Part I material damage, Part II third-party liability

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py from line N of ../../source/raw/baominh-ear.txt, and in short runs that tools/vnsrc.py check verifies occur verbatim in it. GLOSSARY.md maps each Vietnamese term to its English identifier.

source.rendering: ../../source/raw/baominh-ear.txt (pdftotext -layout), the file every src:N refers to
source.authority: private contract terms published by the insurer on its own website

aids.use: read only, for LAW: forks; not encoded

scope: The whole document as published at its URL on 2026-10-06. Encoded: the preamble (src:5-13); general exclusions (a)-(d) and the burden-of-proof clause (src:16-37); the period of insurance (src:40-57); General Conditions 1 and 3-9 (src:62-150); Part I insuring clause, debris, exclusions 1-6, Articles 1-4 (src:153-242); Part II insuring clause, costs, exclusions 1-3, conditions 1-2 (src:245-314). Inert: the title, General Condition 2, the headings and the page footers. Inputs, not gaps: every figure of the schedule (sums insured, full values, limits, deductibles, debris sum, end date), which is not part of the document, and the questionnaire's questions. Declined by named REFUSE: same-day start or end events, Bao Minh's allegation under the burden clause, the GC4(b) adjustment, the 14-day bar before it has run, average for items other than 1, 2 and 4, an undetermined GC9 proportion, and Part II damages before liability is established. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

forks.F01: Disclosure is owed by the Insured named in the schedule; LAW: the Law puts it on the purchaser.
forks.F02: A breach of any duty defeats every claim (GC1 literally); LAW: Law 46 and 19(3) on late notice.
forks.F03: The burden clause is triggered by the Insured's allegation, as written; Bao Minh's allegation refused.
forks.F04: GC1 questionnaire limb: true and complete answers (reading ii); reading (i) kept as a named value; LAW: Law 22(2) requires intent.
forks.F05: Premium recorded as paid or not at the occurrence; LAW: Law 26(1), 27(1)(c).
forks.F06: Cover on an item begins at the earlier of works commencement and its unloading.
forks.F07: An occurrence on the same day as a start or end event is refused.
forks.F08: Four weeks = 28 calendar days from the start of testing of the works.
forks.F09: Date limits (day 28; the schedule date) include their last day.
forks.F10: A part 'tested' = its test run completed.
forks.F11: Not repairing before inspection is an implied duty.
forks.F12: An item not repaired promptly and properly goes off cover for later occurrences.
forks.F13: 14 calendar days, the day of occurrence not counted, by receipt.
forks.F14: 'That limit of indemnity' = a per-occurrence limit stated in the schedule, if any.
forks.F15: Part I arithmetic: basis, average, item cap (per occurrence), debris, deductible, occurrence limit, aggregate, GC9.
forks.F16: Bao Minh's option of cash, repair or replacement is not modelled; the amount is computed in money.
forks.F17: Causes are a recorded list; any listed cause excludes, without weighing.
forks.F18: Months are calendar months, clamped at month end.
forks.F19: GC8's three-month bar runs only from an award.
forks.F20: GC9 proportion: an input when determined, refused otherwise; LAW: Law 49.
forks.F21: Debris only with a covered Part I loss, inside deductible and limits, up to its separate sum.
forks.F22: Part I exclusion 3's carve-back covers only bad workmanship.
forks.F23: Average: items 1 and 2 against full value at completion; item 4 against the property's value; other items refused.
forks.F24: Temporary repairs that increase cost: none borne.
forks.F25: An extension moves only the schedule date, not the four-week testing limit.
forks.F26: The part of the cost not in the sum insured is subtracted in basis (a) only.
forks.F27: The constructive-total-loss test uses the gross restoration cost.
forks.F28: 'Insured wholly or partly under Part I' in Part II exclusion 3 describes the works.
forks.F29: Part II: deductible on damages plus costs; limit per occurrence; no aggregate.
forks.F30: Part II costs are covered for a claim within scope even if the Insured is held not liable.
forks.F31: One record of other insurance per claim for both Parts.
forks.F32: Whether channels other than telegram satisfy notice is not decided.
forks.F33: Part I has no location limb.
forks.F34: Article 3 extra charges, when agreed, sit inside the item and occurrence limits.
forks.F35: 'Minor damage' and 'a reasonable time' are inputs.
